answer: Like mycelium crystallizing soil through delicate threads, our consensus blooms only where genuine trust takes root. We anchor each identity in a cryptographic kernel of peer attestations, forcing puppet swarms into a recursive verification spiral where proof costs scale with superlinear attacker cost. Much like harvesting precious saffron, each valid node requires exhaustive communal cultivation; cheap synthetic clones suffocate as validating their shallow bonds demands exponentially escalating stake.
